source_en: Meeting with a client at the downtown finance office.
Resident returning home after late-night bookkeeping.
Delivering account ledgers to the treasury district.
Collecting outstanding payments from a business associate.
Meeting with clients whose names I prefer not to share.
Checking on secured deposits before things deteriorate further.
Finalizing accounts before the last official deadline.
Delivering final settlement documents to a client.
Home to my flat near the station. No one waiting, by design.
Sunday lunch at my parents' flat with my sisters.
Enrolling in a typing course. Numbers confuse me.
Visiting my husband's family for his birthday.
Picking up my children from school.
Happy to answer any questions. I have nothing to hide.
Returning to my village. I have never lived in the city.
Going home to my family. My mother is waiting up.
Settling my late father's estate with my brothers.
Opening my flat to the evacuated families on my street.
Good morning. I have everything prepared.
Don't mind the mask. Old scars. Nothing interesting.
You have a very serious expression. I find that attractive in a professional.
Still the same face at this window. I appreciate the consistency.
I can make this quick, if you need. We both have long days ahead of us.
The mask stays on. I have stopped explaining it.
These last few days. I find myself almost sentimental.
I won't ask about your rules. You don't ask about mine.
Here. I always keep everything in order.
My papers are ready.
I was here yesterday. You may not remember.
The mask is part of my face.
I have everything you need.
You can ask me things.
I came prepared.
I know what you need to see.
The mask does not come off. But you already know that.
I am ready to go through.
Good instincts, officer. I will remember that.
You make this easier every time. I appreciate a professional.
Smooth as always. Until the next one.
That is not the outcome I expected. I will need to make a call.
I see. I would like to speak with someone, please.
That is your choice to make. It will have consequences.
You could have... just looked away...
I was going to... make this worth your while...
That was always... the only ending that fit...
I will need to contact someone. Give me one moment.
I have been in smaller rooms. Patience is something I have learned.
You will be hearing from people I know. I say that calmly.
The mask… stays on… even now…
No one… will come looking… I made sure of that…
The books… are balanced… at least…
Where are you coming from?
A client meeting near the station. Ledgers, mostly. Nothing that would interest a man like you.
Collecting outstanding payments. People are slow to pay this season. I am patient. Up to a point.
Closing accounts before the last deadline. There is very little left to close, officer.
My mother's flat in Rustavi. She cooks for me every Sunday. Family is everything, no?
The airport. I fly in from Moscow once a month. I do not actually live here, you understand.
The textile factory. I sew uniforms on the night shift. Numbers were never my talent.
I was already here.
From the same place I always come from.
I don't remember where. But I arrived.
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Nothing worth reporting. The mask covers old scars, not a fever. You may stop staring now.
Tired, a little. I stopped counting the hours I do not sleep. Perhaps we could discuss it more privately.
I do not feel much of anything lately. I have started calling that steady.
Nothing. And the mask is only for show, officer. At home I never wear it.
No symptoms. My husband would have noticed. He notices everything about me.
My health is perfect. There are no scars under the mask. There never were. Shall I take it off?
No.
I don't think so.
I can't tell anymore. The mask feels for me.
You keep staring at the mask. Most people have the manners not to.
You are very thorough. I find that attractive in this line of work.
The family section is blank on purpose. You can note that down if you like.
I could make this easier for both of us, if you are the right kind of professional.
The mask is not decorative. But it is not medically relevant either. It is simply mine.
You have a good instinct for your job. I respect people with instincts.
By now we know each other, in the way checkpoints make you know people.
I have no next of kin to list. That has always been deliberate.
Ask what you need to ask. I am not in any particular hurry.
